arithmetic_long_context_compatibility.decision: For the full-run Arithmetic compatibility path only, replace limit_past with a repository-owned shim that converts DynamicCache to legacy tuple layers and retains the last 1022 entries on the modern sequence axis [:, :, -1022:, :]. Patch the public author decoder with the same shim only while collecting the non-gating text-transport diagnostic.
arithmetic_long_context_compatibility.if_compatibility_shim_fails: Do not accept the shard; stop and review before Step 3.11.
arithmetic_long_context_compatibility.resume_compatibility: Already completed shards remain reusable. Any accepted record that never required sequence-axis trimming is byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged; failed long-context Arithmetic work is regenerated.
arithmetic_long_context_compatibility.root_cause: The pinned 2025 utils.limit_past tuple-cache branch keeps the historical slice key[:, :, :, -1022:]. Historical stacked GPT-2 caches used [2,batch,heads,seq,head_dim], where dimension 3 is sequence. Modern tuple/DynamicCache key/value tensors use [batch,heads,seq,head_dim], where that same slice trims head_dim instead of sequence. The cache can therefore grow beyond GPT-2 Medium's 1024 learned positions and trigger a CUDA embedding index assertion.
arithmetic_long_context_compatibility.scope: author-compatible full Figure-3 Arithmetic runner and its diagnostic decoder only
arithmetic_long_context_compatibility.short_run_parity_expectation: No behavior change before the cache exceeds 1022 sequence positions; existing fixed-message mirror parity remains exact.
arithmetic_long_context_compatibility.trigger: During the resumed Arithmetic sweep a CUDA indexSelectSmallIndex assertion occurred on a long first-boundary sample after the full-run sentence cap had been raised above the Step-3.9 pilot range.
